channel.title: The Nevada Independent - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Nevada Independent (thenevadaindependent.com)

item.title: Sam Brown, excandidato al Senado, no se postulará para cargo vacante de Nevada en el Congreso
item.description: Su decisión deja el terreno abierto para unas reñidas elecciones primarias para el cargo, que ha estado en manos Republicanas y está vacante por primera vez en 15 años.

item.title: OPINION: Want more affordable housing? Build more houses.
item.description: Productive housing policy should focus on expanding supply across all price points and housing types. Policies that restrict development or target specific ownership structures may generate headlines, but they will not lower rents or home prices.

item.title: Does ICE have authority to act on tribal lands?
item.description: Does ICE have authority to act on tribal lands?

item.title: Titus targets prediction markets as the battle to protect sports betting intensifies
item.description: The Nevada congresswoman introduces a bill to ban Kalshi and others from offering sports “contracts” without approval from states. Also, M Resort boosts Penn.

item.title: Nevada senators support unsuccessful push to rein in Trump’s war on Iran
item.description: Democrats representing the state in Congress have expressed support for some of the president’s stated aims while raising concerns about his approach.

item.title: Nevada tiene pocas estaciones para carga de vehículos eléctricos a pesar de millonaria inversión
item.description: El Departamento de Transporte de Nevada y NV Energy estaban a punto de invertir un total de $138 millones en la construcción de estaciones de carga para vehículos eléctricos en todo el estado. Cinco años después, solo se han invertido $12 millones.

item.title: OPINION: From pundits to partisan trends, national matters cloud all political races
item.description: Somewhere amid all the noise of primary bickering there had better be a contingent of primary voters willing to consider the more moderate pragmatism that is often needed to actually win in general elections.

item.title: ‘This agency kind of raised me’: Nevada’s first female forester reflects on 24-year career
item.description: Kacey KC turned a love of the outdoors into a lengthy state career, becoming Nevada’s first female forester and fire warden. She left the state in February to take over the Oregon Department of Forestry.

item.title: Was Michele Fiore’s suspension as Nevada judge legal? Nevada Supreme Court hears arguments
item.description: The hearing largely centerd on whether the state's judicial commission had authority to impose the suspension. It also covered whether the high court can intervene in the case, even though the commission’s suspension is pending further investigation.

item.title: Fin de una era: Cayó el Hotel Eastside Cannery tras implosión controlada
item.description: Este no es el único hotel que ha sido demolido. En 2024, Las Vegas fue testigo de la implosión del Hotel Tropicana.
